description: This file contains functions for value range analysis and precision reduction in a PyTorch compiler optimization pass, specifically targeting index and dtype operations within a loop body.

classes.name: LoopBody
classes.description: Represents a loop body in the optimization process, providing methods for bounds and node retrieval.

methods.name: val_expressable_in_32_bits
methods.description: Checks if a given value can be expressed within 32-bit bounds.

methods.name: range_expressable_in_32_bits
methods.description: Checks if both bounds of a range are expressible within 32 bits.

methods.name: try_to_reduce_precision
methods.description: Attempts to reduce the precision of a node's dtype to int32 if possible, considering dominance and bounds.

methods.name: indexing_dtype_strength_reduction
methods.description: Performs value range analysis to reduce index and dtype precisions from int64 to int32 within a loop body.
